reply_text:
I replied to Pree in the thread on their #central-team message. I confirmed I'd noted that the signed Tansley Parcel order form is due 25 August. I also pointed out that today is 14 October 2026, so 25 August 2026 has already passed, and asked whether they meant 25 August 2027 or an earlier deadline.

The brain has nothing else about this deadline, but its search was keyword-only, so that doesn't prove nothing exists. The date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to discuss in the channel. I didn't take any other action: their message is saved to the brain automatically, and I'll record the year once they confirm it.
